'''Jon Arco''' was a notorious [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] living at some point before the [[Galactic War]]. He and his ship disappeared in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and the only trace was his old [[Star map/Legends|astrogation charts]].
